description: Chrome browser screenshot (448x527 px) showing the Antimatter Dimensions game UI with both horizontal and vertical scrollbars visible simultaneously. In the bottom-right corner where the two scrollbars intersect, a solid white square (~16x16 px) is clearly visible against the game's dark background. This is the browser's default ::-webkit-scrollbar-corner widget, which the game's custom scrollbar CSS styles (targeting ::-webkit-scrollbar, ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb) do not cover, leaving it with the default white/light appearance rather than being transparent or matching the game's dark theme.
